look: Chalk geometry: a dark maths-explainer look (3Blue1Brown-style): clean vector dots, arrows and grids drawn in glowing strokes on a dark ground, shapes morphing smoothly, short serif captions. Same look as the Poisson, Metrics, IER, MeshAnything, Point2Mesh and DHSP Part 1 films of this series.
